prompts.club-outdoors-photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: editorial landscape photograph for a fitness community website, approximately 3:2 landscape. A candid documentary photograph of four fictional ordinary adult recreational runners walking together along the edge of an urban park after an easy training session. Two women and two men around 25–40, believable varied everyday athletic builds, naturally interacting with each other instead of posing for the camera. One person listens, two talk, another smiles subtly, no synchronized poses, no staged high five. One holds a plain reusable bottle. Medium-wide framing from the side at chest height, all four people fit within the central 75% of the image, heads and hands entirely visible, crop around mid-thigh. Trees, pale stone path and distant unfocused low architecture, not a famous location. Quiet cloudy late-afternoon daylight; tactile natural skin, real fabric seams and creases, believable hands, authentic optical depth, restrained 35mm sports-editorial photography. Clothing palette graphite, dark sage, off-white, one muted ochre running jacket; natural muted greenery. Carefully composed but not glossy generic fitness advertising. Absolutely photographic realism, not 3D rendering, not illustration, not clay, not sculpture, not cartoon, not plastic skin, not cinematic orange/teal grading. No phones, screens, text, logos, medals, race numbers, signage, watermarks or exaggerated muscles. Fictional scene, not an image of real Deviny users. No transparency, fill the entire rectangular photograph.
prompts.program-strength-photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: close-up editorial photograph illustrating a training program on a refined fitness website, landscape 3:2. A quiet, believable real gym still life: one worn dark iron adjustable dumbbell on a black rubber floor beside the edge of a pale wood workout bench; an open real paper training notebook and simple black pencil lie on the bench, and a folded off-white cotton towel hangs naturally over its near edge. Notebook pages have only subtle faint empty ruled lines, absolutely no legible text or numbers. Camera low three-quarter close-up with dumbbell and notebook both recognizable and sharp enough, natural optical shallow depth in the far gym background. Soft side daylight, genuine granular rubber, matte iron with small scuffs, wood grain, unretouched paper and woven cotton. A small subdued ochre towel stripe is the only gold accent. Palette graphite green-black, off-white and warm pale wood, sophisticated natural sports equipment photography. Objects have real-world scale and grounded contact shadows. Compose the essential subjects around the middle of frame so a wide 2.3:1 crop remains meaningful. No people, logos, phones, UI, app screenshots, claims, scores, measurements or watermarks. Strictly an actual-looking camera photograph, not a 3D render, sculptural still life, ceramic imitation, cartoon, floating objects, glow or icon. No transparency, full rectangular image.
prompts.program-nutrition-photo: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: close-up editorial food photograph for the nutrition-program option of a refined fitness website, landscape 3:2. Beside the bowl, a linen napkin and small wooden cutting board with half an avocado and a few herb leaves; only these few objects, no styled clutter. Camera at a gentle three-quarter overhead angle, bowl prominent, realistic appetizing food textures with uneven cuts and natural moisture, soft grounded shadows, believable optical depth. Quiet pale warm stone table, charcoal linen and muted green food tones, slight natural gold in cooked grains. Real contemporary food editorial photograph, neither a diet advertisement nor a medical or nutritional prescription. Keep all important objects in the central region for a wide 2.3:1 crop. No hands, people, text, recipe, numbers, calorie labels, logos, devices, screens or watermarks.
